decisions.rationale: 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy' in the title names one specific, defined disease (DMD) with no further categorization, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (Duplicate mentions in title and abstract)

decisions.rationale: 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy' in the abstract is the same specific disease as in the title and is annotated again as a duplicate mention in its own sentence.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (Duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'DMD' in parentheses is the abbreviation of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, referring to the same disease. Abbreviation definitions are annotated as a separate mention from the long form.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (Synonymous mentions and abbreviations)

decisions.rationale: 'DMD' in 'haplotype analysis of the DMD locus' is the gene symbol for the locus, not a reference to the disease. It is not a disease mention even when used as a modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers require a disease mention); What NOT to Annotate 1 (Non-disease entity names)

decisions.rationale: 'DMD' in 'the DMD gene' refers to the gene carrying the mutation, not to the disease. It denotes a gene name, so it is not annotated as a disease mention or modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers require a disease mention); What NOT to Annotate 1 (Non-disease entity names)
